correctness.rationale: For a rank-two PSD A=B^T B, the exact Nyström residual is B^T(I-P_{BΩ})B and vanishes if and only if m independent projected sign vectors span R². Conditioning on two linearly independent columns of B gives P(Bε=0)≤1/4. For any projective line L, nontrivial one-dimensional sign anti-concentration yields P(Bε∈L)≤1/2. Thus z≤1/4, p_L≤1/2−z and Σp_L=1−z. Convex majorization by (1/2−z,1/2−z,z) proves failure F_m≤2^(1−m)+(2^m−2)z^m≤3·2^(−m)−2·4^(−m). The displayed 2×3 B gives z=p_1=p_2=p_3=1/4, attaining equality for all m. For n=2 invertibility gives exactly two equiprobable projective lines and F_m=2^(1−m). The verifier reproduces 65,093 integer-exact assertions, including exhaustive finite coefficient examples; the universal claim follows from the proof, not extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The exact all-m worst-case Rademacher Nyström rank-loss probability and dimension-two versus dimension-three boundary were compared with published non-Gaussian sketch guarantees, low-rank projection expectations, structured Hadamard Nyström analyses, and nearest accessible research records. Those comparisons do not entail the formula: the general guarantees do not fix the exact rank-two atomic failure constant, the projection expectation theorem operates under a high-stable-rank assumption, and structured Hadamard sketches have a different distribution. Ordinary anti-concentration bounds are prior lemmas, not novelty claims. Remaining specialist precedence risk is explicit.

value.rationale: Exact recovery is an intrinsic success criterion for rank-two positive-semidefinite Nyström approximations, and iid sign sketches have a genuine collision probability even on exact low-rank inputs. A sharp all-budget worst-case formula determines the discrete sketch count needed for any fixed rank-loss tolerance. It shows a discontinuous ambient-dimension effect already at n=3 and a minimal extremizer. At m=2 the sharp failure is 5/8 instead of the unconditionally 1/2 rate at n=2, and the discrepancy persists by the closed form for every m. This is a natural complete classification of a parameter, not a gratuitous small-m numerical record. It does not assert practical improvement or broad approximation guarantees.
